title: Nebius Group N.V. unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30 cash was USD 8.0421 billion, debt was USD 8.5457 billion, and current plus non-current deferred revenue was USD 5.9752 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed Q2 statements support a fresh revenue-multiple valuation while requiring explicit treatment of extraordinary capital intensity, net debt, customer-funded cash flow, concentration, convertibles, anti-dilutive awards and share-count dilution.
